description: This is a server entry point file for a Remix application, responsible for handling HTTP requests and rendering server-side responses, including bot detection and response streaming.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main exported function to handle incoming HTTP requests, sets CORS headers, detects bots, and delegates request handling accordingly.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot requests, streams the HTML response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser requests, streams the HTML response.
